about: Questions on world-v2 (set v3, after the review 20261109-world-v2-gemma-glm.review.md) (history.json with notes that follow the dates). Today is Monday 9 November 2026 in America/Denver; the questions give dates, except w04, which tests 'this Wednesday'. Scores use regular expressions (re_all, re_any, re_none) on the lower-case reply. A reply that says it does not know fails an answerable question. Actions are checked in catalystcal and Longhouse (magi-world -extras), not by a model. Do not change this file after a run; make a new version. Each question has 'truth' (the answer from world.py). re_none matches are excused only by an excuse word within 6 words (the question's 'excuse' list, or the short global list).
